taskOverrides.topology: FSDP=8 cross-node · granular attention/MLP units · NDR400
taskOverrides.scope: 2 dense Qwen-shaped layers · analytical cross-node granular FSDP
description: This variant keeps every measured attention, MLP, root, and embedding compute duration from the granular TorchTitan trace and changes only FSDP AG/RS communication to cross-node NDR400 InfiniBand.

Attention and MLP remain separate FSDP states. MLP RS becomes ready after MLP backward and can begin while attention backward runs; attention RS follows attention backward on the same serialized reduction stream.

Each explicit backward prefetch is submitted at the triggering module's pre-backward boundary. NVLink GPU-start offsets are not carried into the IB model because they are topology- and scheduler-dependent.
Each rank uses one 400 Gb/s rail modeled at 42.5 GB/s effective. Total parameter bytes per layer are unchanged relative to whole-layer wrapping, but readiness is finer-grained.
taskOverrides.insight: Splitting attention and MLP starts MLP reduce-scatter earlier; it does not reduce communicated bytes.

verification.label: Analytical granular NDR400 model · measured TorchTitan ordering
verification.implementation: Measured attention/MLP FSDP2 order with byte-derived cross-node collectives and dependency rescheduling
verification.workload: Same two dense Qwen-shaped layers and granular FSDP states; only FSDP communication changes to one NDR400 rail per rank.
verification.measurement: 68.674 ms modeled window; 9.426 ms shorter than whole-layer IB. Attention AG=2.986 ms, MLP AG=6.268 ms, attention RS=5.922 ms, MLP RS=12.485 ms.

l0-attn-fwd-ag.description: Materialize L0 attention and attention-norm parameters from eight FSDP shards. Duration is analytically modeled over cross-node NDR400 InfiniBand.

l0-mlp-fwd-ag.description: L0 attention prefetches the separate dense SwiGLU FSDP state while attention computes. Duration is analytically modeled over cross-node NDR400 InfiniBand.

l0-mlp-fwd.description: MLP parameter copy-out, FFN norm, gate/up/down GEMMs, activation, and residual. Compute waits for the corresponding L0 MLP AG.

l1-attn-fwd-ag.description: L0 MLP prefetches the next layer's attention state. Duration is analytically modeled over cross-node NDR400 InfiniBand.

l1-attn-fwd.description: Layer 1 attention forward using its independently gathered state. Compute waits for the corresponding L1 attention AG.

l1-mlp-fwd-ag.description: L1 attention prefetches its MLP state while earlier compute remains in flight. Duration is analytically modeled over cross-node NDR400 InfiniBand.

l1-mlp-fwd.description: Layer 1 dense MLP forward with its own FSDP state. Compute waits for the corresponding L1 MLP AG.

root-fwd-ag.description: Prefetch the final norm/output state while layer 1 computes. Duration is analytically modeled over cross-node NDR400 InfiniBand.

l1-mlp-bwd-ag.description: The root module reconstructs L1 MLP parameters first because MLP backward executes first. Duration is analytically modeled over cross-node NDR400 InfiniBand.

root-rs.description: Shard root gradients after root backward. Duration is analytically modeled over cross-node NDR400 InfiniBand.

l1-attn-bwd-ag.description: L1 MLP backward prefetches L1 attention parameters. Duration is analytically modeled over cross-node NDR400 InfiniBand.

l1-mlp-rs.description: Starts about 6 µs after L1 MLP gradient packing and overlaps L1 attention backward. Duration is analytically modeled over cross-node NDR400 InfiniBand.

l0-mlp-bwd-ag.description: Triggered by the L1 attention pre-backward hook, not by completion of the L1 attention AG. The measured AG stream is therefore idle until autograd enters L1 attention backward. Duration is analytically modeled over cross-node NDR400 InfiniBand.

l1-attn-rs.description: Starts after L1 attention gradient packing and overlaps L0 MLP backward. It is ready earlier but waits behind the serialized L1 MLP RS.

l0-attn-bwd-ag.description: L0 MLP backward prefetches the final attention state. Duration is analytically modeled over cross-node NDR400 InfiniBand.

l0-mlp-rs.description: Starts after L0 MLP packing and overlaps L0 attention backward. It is ready earlier but waits behind the serialized L1 attention RS.

embedding-bwd-ag.description: Prefetch embedding parameters outside the two-layer puzzle. Duration is analytically modeled over cross-node NDR400 InfiniBand.

l0-attn-rs.description: Shard L0 attention gradients after their flat-gradient pack. It is ready earlier but waits behind the serialized L0 MLP RS.

embedding-rs.description: The final embedding RS closes the captured window. Duration is analytically modeled over cross-node NDR400 InfiniBand.
